name: Meeting Minutes
description: Formal minutes: attendees, agenda, discussion by item, decisions and actions, as a record of the meeting.

sections.title: Meeting Details
sections.instruction: Give the meeting title and date from the transcript header, and list the attendees named or introduced in the recording. Write 'Not stated' for anything not mentioned.

sections.title: Agenda
sections.instruction: List the agenda items in the order they were discussed. Use an agenda if one was read out; otherwise list the topics as they came up, with [mm:ss].

sections.title: Discussion
sections.instruction: For each agenda item, summarise the discussion neutrally in the third person: the points raised, by whom when it is clear, and any disagreement. Include [mm:ss].

sections.title: Decisions
sections.instruction: List each decision exactly as agreed, with [mm:ss]. Do not include proposals that were not agreed.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List each action with its owner and due date only if they were stated; otherwise write 'Not stated'. Include [mm:ss].

sections.title: Next Meeting
sections.instruction: State the date, time or plan for the next meeting if it was mentioned; otherwise write 'Not stated'.
